description:
Free Orbit
Version 1.2 | For Starsector 0.98a-RC8

What does this mod do?

While your fleet is orbiting a planet, station, or any other body, your ships consume zero supplies for maintenance. The moment you leave orbit, normal supply consumption resumes automatically.

No buttons to press, no commands to run - it just works passively in the background.

Why I made this

I found it annoying that supplies kept draining even when I was just sitting in orbit waiting, trading, or managing my fleet. If you are docked at a station you do not pay for upkeep - why should orbiting cost anything? This mod fixes that.

Features

Automatic - activates whenever your fleet status is "Orbiting"
Works around planets, stations, and any other orbital body
Optional LunaLib integration - configure the supply reduction percentage in Mod Settings (0 to 100%, default 100%)
Version Checker support - get notified when updates are available

Requirements

Starsector 0.98a-RC8
LunaLib (optional, for configurable reduction amount)

Installation

1. Download the zip below
2. Extract the FreeOrbit folder into your Starsector/mods/ directory
3. Enable the mod in the launcher

Download

FreeOrbit_v1.2.zip (GitHub Releases)

Source code on GitHub

Changelog

v1.2
- Fixed LunaLib detection to use isModEnabled() - more reliable than the previous approach (thanks WolframSegler!)
- Added Version Checker support
- Renamed setting to "Supply Reduction Percent" for clarity

v1.1
- Added optional LunaLib support for configurable supply reduction percentage

v1.0
- Initial release
